pick.name: Stripe Billing (incl. Metronome)
pick.what: Subscriptions plus metered billing; Stripe owns Metronome
pick.why: Largest ecosystem; Metronome adds high-scale metering
pick.free_limits: Billing 0.7% of billing volume (pay-as-you-go); Metronome Startup 0.8% of billing volume + $0.04 per 1K ingest events (Metronome figure not re-verified)

best_free.name: Lago (self-host)
best_free.why: Free if you host it; no vendor lock-in
best_free.free_limits: Self-host free; managed Lago Cloud/Premium is quote-based; payments need a processor

alts.name: Polar usage-based billing
alts.free_limits: No separate subscription fee on Starter+; docs flagged parts as alpha/new; Polar doesn't block usage past credits (you must)

alts.name: Dodo Payments usage-based billing
alts.what: Meters (count/sum/max/last), event ingestion API, credits, LLM token ingestion blueprints
alts.why: Metering + invoicing + tax in your MoR: no separate billing system
alts.free_limits: +0.5% on usage/subscription billing on top of MoR rate; events POST /events/ingest with event_id, customer_id, event_name

candidates.name: Orb
candidates.verdict: Acquired by Adyen 2026-07-01 per search; no public pricing

candidates.name: Metronome
candidates.verdict: Acquired by Stripe (announced Dec 2025, completed Jan 2026 per search)

decision: Stripe Billing is the best overall when Stripe is your processor; Metronome now sits inside Stripe for high-scale metering. Use Lago when you need processor-independent metering and accept AGPL self-hosting. If you sell through a merchant of record, keep metering in Polar or Dodo so one ledger handles tax.
details: Flagged 2025-2026 changes: Metronome to Stripe (completed Jan 2026), Orb to Adyen (agreed 11 Jun 2026 for USD 335M, closing expected about 1 Jul 2026), OpenMeter to Kong (Sept 2025). Pick was Dodo UBB.
